objective: Deliver EduAI 2.0 through stabilization, platform administration, assessment hardening, notifications, AI learning paths, Career Hub, mentoring, and production readiness without rebuilding verified V1 capabilities.

inScope: Sprint 13 stabilization, live API audit, navigation completion, and V1 regression coverage.
Sprint 14 platform administration, moderation, and immutable audit history.
Sprint 15 authoritative completion, assessment policies, resubmission/rubrics, and automatic certificates.
Sprint 16 notification domain, in-app center, realtime SSE, and email preferences.
Sprint 17 learner goals, AI learning paths, learning dashboard, and course-grounded tutor.
Sprint 18 Career Hub profiles, jobs, applications, and explainable skill matching.
Sprint 19 mentor profiles, booking, Jitsi sessions, notes, goals, and reviews.
Sprint 20 security, observability, performance/accessibility, UAT, and production release verification.

Sprint 21 priority product experience track: P0 mobile UX/navigation/price/regression, P1 voucher/scholarship/TMI rewards, P2 PWA installability, then P3 final demo dataset and integrated regression/UAT; minimal test fixtures are support-only.
outOfScope: Rebuilding home, course, student dashboard, or instructor dashboard flows already verified to use live APIs.
Generic replacement of mock data without a factual page-to-endpoint gap.
Unrelated visual redesigns or changes to established APIs and business logic.
Modifying reusable AI-DOS framework files with project-specific facts.

releaseCriteria: All applicable task acceptance criteria have structured passing evidence and no task is marked DONE from code presence alone.
Backend and frontend production builds, relevant automated suites, migrations, and cross-role regression journeys pass.
All P0 defects are closed and P1 defects are fixed or explicitly accepted.
Security, ownership, rate limits, observability, accessibility, performance, deployment, rollback, and production verification requirements pass.

extensions.sourcePolicy: Human-authored source material is preserved; canonical execution state is maintained in .ai-dos/records.
